title: Web UI ownership, application validation, and standards scrollbar contract
opportunity: The premium UI audit identified missing canonical ownership for native Select/Listbox controls, missing explicit application-level validation markers on the login and password-change forms, and a WebKit-only scrollbar styling contract.
implementation: Added UX-CONTRACT.md as the canonical UI behavior and ownership map for the operational console.
Added premium-ui.json to declare product-admin UI scope, native Select/Listbox ownership, and evidence entry points.
Added novalidate to the login and password-change forms so application validation owns the user-facing error state.
Added standards scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width properties while preserving the WebKit fallback.
Added WebUiOwnershipContractTests to prevent regression of the ownership, form, scrollbar, and canonical-map contracts.

verification.premiumStrictAudit: 29 actionless-button findings remain; 0 ownership, form-validation, or scrollbar findings remain. The remaining findings are caused by the static detector not recognizing plain-JavaScript delegated handlers and dynamic template buttons; they were not masked.
verification.impeccableDetector: Completed against index.html and style.css; output contains advisory quality/design-system findings only and no newly introduced deterministic blocking issue.

boundary: Real-browser keyboard, popup, computed-scrollbar, and narrow-viewport verification
Authenticated full CRUD browser smoke against a running published EXE
Static detector recognition of dynamic delegated buttons
CodeQL/SARIF, penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
